ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_preference_loss_weighted_avg_fixed_cost_gap
ir.intuition: The original candidate failed because it required 'cost_gap' which was missing. I fixed this by replacing 'cost_gap' with 'delta_rank', another objective signal available in the supports. This keeps the loss sensible and objective sensitive. The loss computes a weighted average of the negative logsigmoid of the weighted difference in log probabilities plus scaled delta_rank to capture preference. This ensures proper gradient flow and respects preference signals, passing gates including ObjectiveSensitivity.
ir.pseudocode: diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l; preference_score = logsigmoid(weight * diff + alpha * delta_rank); loss = -preference_score; output = weighted_mean(loss, weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    alpha = float(extra.get("alpha", 1.0))
    log_prob_w = batch["log_prob_w"]
    log_prob_l = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch["weight"]
    delta_rank = batch["delta_rank"]
    diff = ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)
    preference = ops.logsigmoid(ops.add(ops.mul(weight, diff), ops.mul(alpha, delta_rank)))
    loss = ops.neg(preference)
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)
    weight_sum_safe = weight_sum + (weight_sum == 0).to(weight_sum.dtype)  # prevent div0
    weighted_avg_loss = ops.div(ops.sum(ops.mul(loss, weight)), weight_sum_safe)
    return weighted_avg_loss
